commands.observation: Fact: the assigned digest preceded focused probes. Inference: the audit began on the assigned epoch.
Fact: 146 operations, 39 return waves, and two hostile mutations validated. Inference: no API-closure defect reproduced.
Fact: five pinned current DAGs reproduced with bound tool and result hashes. Inference: no architecture-DAG drift reproduced.
Fact: recursive snapshots distinguished two dirty gitlink states and rejected a symlink. Inference: no consumer snapshot escape reproduced.
Fact: deletion vocabulary joined once and three hostile nonjoins were rejected. Inference: no deletion-truth bypass reproduced.
Fact: Value and Keyframes each had distinct phone and desktop audit matrices. Inference: no design viewport-side omission reproduced.
Fact: 193 contracts produced 193 canonical gates and 797 typed edges. Inference: no missing or duplicate wave gate reproduced.
Fact: C14 bound parse-that 1.0.0 and 17 tests while rejecting a wrong-count control. Inference: no parser substitution reproduced.
Fact: 149 seed blocks formed an exact bijection and reverse-joined 149 owner contracts. Inference: no prompt demand was orphaned.
Fact: four hostile quarantine paths were rejected before target I/O. Inference: no forbidden traversal reproduced.
Fact: P00 bound recursive dependency and artifact-union canaries before mutation. Inference: no return-validator ownership gap reproduced.
Fact: 21 route rows coexisted with one router, popstate, and bounded-codec laws. Inference: no parallel state route reproduced.
Fact: 193 eight-cell waves formed eight bands and an acyclic 797-edge graph. Inference: no malformed or cyclic wave reproduced.
Fact: the same digest followed focused probes. Inference: no audited corpus drift occurred.
